001package io.github.ai4ci.abm;
002
003import java.util.List;
004import java.util.Optional;
005import java.util.stream.Collectors;
006import java.util.stream.IntStream;
007
008import org.immutables.value.Value;
009
010/**
011 * The historical state of the whole model. This is typically used to collect
012 * summary statistics for output from the {@link OutbreakState}, but also can
013 * play a role in informing the {@link io.github.ai4ci.abm.policy.PolicyModel}
014 *
015 * OutbreakHistory items are generated from OutbreakState items using the
016 * {@link HistoryMapper} during the update cycle.
017 */
018@Value.Immutable
019@SuppressWarnings("immutable")
020public interface OutbreakHistory extends OutbreakTemporalState {
021
022        /**
023         *
024         * The current state of knowledge about people with test negative results
025         * from this day (which is potentially in the past) as assessed at current
026         * simulation time. <br>
027         * An observed value:
028         *
029         * @return the number of people with all negative test results reported for
030         *         tests taken on this day, as observed at the current simulation
031         *         time.
032         */
033        default int getCurrentTestNegativesBySampleDate() {
034                return this.getTestNegativesBySampleDate(
035                        this.getEntity()
036                                .getCurrentState()
037                                .getTime()
038                );
039        }
040
041        /**
042         * An observed value:<br>
043         * <br>
044         * The current state of knowledge about test positive results from samples
045         * taken on this day (potentially in the past). This is output as part of the
046         * delay distribution of tests, as it gives a positive test count for a given
047         * day that increases in the future. (N.B. This looks over complicated and I
048         * question its utility, it is also misleading as it is a count of people
049         * with any positive test)
050         *
051         * @return the number of people with any positive test result reported for
052         *         tests taken on this day, as observed at the current simulation
053         *         time.
054         */
055        default int getCurrentTestPositivesBySampleDate() {
056                return this.getTestPositivesBySampleDate(
057                        this.getEntity()
058                                .getCurrentState()
059                                .getTime()
060                );
061        }
062
063        /**
064         * Internal helper function for looking at delay of test results
065         *
066         * @return the maximum delay of test results for any person in the model, as
067         *         observed in the history. This is used to determine how far forward
068         *         to look when calculating test positive/negative counts by sample
069         *         date.
070         */
071        @Value.Lazy
072        default int getMaxDelay() {
073                return ModelNav.peopleHistory(this)
074                        .mapToInt(PersonHistory::getMaxDelay)
075                        .max()
076                        .orElse(0);
077        }
078
079        /**
080         * The previous entry in the history of this outbreak.
081         *
082         * @return An optional containing the previous history entry, or empty if
083         *         this is the first entry (time=0).
084         */
085        default Optional<OutbreakHistory> getPrevious() {
086                return this.getEntity()
087                        .getHistoryEntry(this.getTime() - 1);
088        }
089
090        /**
091         *
092         * The number of people with all tests reported as negative on the given day
093         * <br>
094         * An observed value:
095         *
096         * @see #getTestPositivesBySampleDate() for the logic here.
097         *
098         * @return a list of counts of people with all negative test results reported
099         *         retrospective to today.
100         */
101        @Value.Lazy
102        default List<Integer> getTestNegativesBySampleDate() {
103                return IntStream.range(0, this.getMaxDelay())
104                        .mapToObj(delay -> ModelNav.peopleHistory(this)
105                                .mapToInt(p -> {
106                                        if (p.getTodaysTests()
107                                                .isEmpty()) return 0;
108                                        // If any of a persons results are positive today
109                                        return p.getResultsBySampleDate(this.getTime() + delay)
110                                                .allMatch(t -> !t.getFinalObservedResult()) ? 1 : 0;
111                                })
112                                .sum())
113                        .collect(Collectors.toList());
114        }
115
116        /**
117         * The total test negatives reported from this day, as reported on another
118         * day (typically in the future). This handles delay distribution of test
119         * results and will tell us what is known about tests taken today on day x.
120         * All tests taken on this day must be negative for the person to count as a
121         * test negative.
122         *
123         * An observed value:<br>
124         *
125         * @param time the simulation time at which to assess the test negative
126         *             counts for
127         * @return the number of people with all negative test results reported for
128         *         tests
129         *
130         */
131        default int getTestNegativesBySampleDate(int time) {
132                var lim = time - this.getTime();
133                if (lim < 0) return 0;
134                return this.getTestNegativesBySampleDate()
135                        .stream()
136                        .limit(lim)
137                        .reduce(Integer::sum)
138                        .orElse(0);
139        }
140
141        /**
142         * An observed value:<br>
143         * <br>
144         * The number of people with tests reported as positive on the day of
145         * testing. looking forward through time until the result is available. The
146         * result is a forward distribution of positive test counts indexed by delay.
147         * So first is the tests with positive results available today, second is
148         * those with results tomorrow etc.
149         *
150         * @return a list of counts of people with any positive test result reported
151         *         retrospective to today.
152         */
153        @Value.Lazy
154        default List<Integer> getTestPositivesBySampleDate() {
155                return IntStream.range(0, this.getMaxDelay())
156                        .mapToObj(delay -> ModelNav.peopleHistory(this)
157                                .mapToInt(p ->
158                        // If any of a persons results are positive today
159                        p.getResultsBySampleDate(this.getTime() + delay)
160                                .anyMatch(t -> t.getFinalObservedResult()) ? 1 : 0)
161                                .sum())
162                        .collect(Collectors.toList());
163        }
164
165        /**
166         * An observed value:<br>
167         * <br>
168         * The total test positive people reported from this day, as reported on
169         * another day (typically in the future). This handles delay distribution of
170         * test results and will tell us what is known about tests taken today on day
171         * X. Any positive value is counted as a test positive person on this day.
172         *
173         * @param time the simulation time at which to assess the test positive
174         *             counts for
175         * @return the number of people with any positive test result reported for
176         *         tests taken on this day, as observed at the given time.
177         */
178        default int getTestPositivesBySampleDate(int time) {
179                var lim = time - this.getTime();
180                if (lim < 0) return 0;
181                return this.getTestPositivesBySampleDate()
182                        .stream()
183                        .limit(lim)
184                        .reduce(Integer::sum)
185                        .orElse(0);
186        }
187
188}
